Meaconing from F1.1 Porcellus at approximately 40 dBm from F1.1 Porcellus at Ramnan of the L1 and L2 bands using receiver RX1.

Meaconing from F1.1 Porcellus at approximately 40 dBm will be conducted from F1.1 Porcellus for 10 minutes of the L1 and L2 bands using receiver RX1. This will be preceded by 5 minutes of PRN jamming at 30 dBm from Bleik (PRN L1, L2, L5, G1, G2, E5b, E6 and B1I). The meaconing will begin 4 minutes after the start of the jamming, resulting in a 1-minute overlap between the two activities.
Meaconing with F1.1 Porcellus using receiver RX1, with ramping power. Power is ramped up from 0.001 W to 10 W and then down again in to 0.001 W in 5 dB steps, with each step lasting for 2 minutes.

One hour of high power jamming from F8.1 Porcus Maior at Ramnan, followed by one hour jamming from both F8.1 Porcus Maior and the community house (S), followed by one hour of jamming from the community house (S). Power output from the community house will be adjusted so that the field strength outside the community house is approximately equal to that from F8.1 Porcus Maior (which will be 50 W).
